facts.fact: The 2026 Estimates of National Expenditure appropriate R28.6 million for FY2026/27 to the e-Government Services and Information Management programme of Vote 11 (DPSA), funded from the National Revenue Fund.
facts.system: Vote 11 DPSA e-Government Services and Information Management, FY2026/27

facts.fact: The same programme's appropriation is R28.6 million for FY2026/27, up from R23.9 million the year before (FY2025/26), per the record's summary line; the record's series reads 24.6/23.9 then 28.6/29.8/30.9.
